ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The file on Cuba is kept in the purple drawer. ... The file on Norway is kept in the pink drawer. ... The file on Philippines is kept in the grey drawer. ... Which colour is the drawer that holds the file on the country whose capital is Oslo?" -> answer org pink; the alt prompt asks about the Philippines (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: grey (answer of bridge alt's statement), purple (answer at the same statement slot), silver (the alt prompt's own answer), pink (answer org kept).
